turns.question: Which channel got us leads most cheaply in September 2026, and what did each lead cost?
turns.answer: Email had the lowest cost per lead in September 2026 (1 to 30 September): EUR 37.50 per lead, ahead of search (EUR 42.07) and social (EUR 52.50). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which channel's leads were the most expensive, at what price?
turns.answer: Social had the most expensive leads in September 2026 (1 to 30 September), at a cost per lead of EUR 52.50. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
